symbols.phrase: Look here at this gentle bird; a sweet message of longing is flying toward you.
See this ornate key resting upon the rim, ready to unlock a guarded, tender soul.
Right in the center, this swollen heart beats with fierce and unspoken romantic devotion.
Notice these two rings joined together; a sacred promise seeks to bind your destinies.
This winding path whispers of patience before two weary travelers finally meet in embrace.
Look at this slender moon cradle; night brings secret yearnings and deeply shared dreams.

conclusion: The grounds do not lie, my dear; your spirit is standing upon the threshold of profound surrender. While the winding path has tested your endurance in solitude, the wings of fate are already carrying sweet news toward your door. The key has been forged to open the chamber of the heart that once remained guarded against hurt. Beneath the silent vigil of the moon, two separate souls are destined to link together as unbreakable rings. Trust in this unfolding, for true love does not pass you by; it returns home to you.
